Vendored miniz 3.1.0, commit 174573d60290f447c13a2b1b3405de2b96e27d6c,
from https://github.com/richgel999/miniz. See LICENSE.

Only the zlib/DEFLATE encoder and CRC code is built. Archive and inflate APIs
are disabled. miniz_export.h defines static linkage exports for this build.
No download or additional installation is needed to build the capture helper.
